reviews.text: Local is always a lovely place to visit with great food and Christina was a great server. Will definitely come back!

Our Local spot. The vibe is lively. The food is consistently delicious. Our server, Mia, was outstanding, friendly and a stellar host.

Whether Hubby and I are without kids around or taking the whole family with us, Local will always be our go-to.
Maria was a great server, incredibly personable, fast service. Also great insight on engagement rings.
Maria was amazing. Excellent customer service and very professional.  Definitely coming back.
Very welcoming and took good care of us.
Qam was an amazing server. Very friendly and gifted us a free dessert for our first visit. I’d highly recommend local as a spot to eat and hangout. The food was great as well. Thanks Qam!
